# UrysohnLadder

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A recursive metric contraction method that constructs scalable hierarchical topologies by iteratively applying the Urysohn metric embedding to reduce dimensionality while preserving distance relationships. Enables efficient routing and clustering in large-scale network topologies, supporting scalable neuromorphic communication and computation.
